info.name: erp-nelgates-postman-collection
info.description:
Garment ERP API — every endpoint the frontend uses, grouped to match the app's modules.

Setup:
1. Set the `base_url` collection variable if your backend isn't at http://localhost:8000/api.
2. Run "Auth → Login" once — its test script saves the returned token into the `token` collection variable automatically. Every other request inherits Bearer {{token}} auth from the collection.
3. Admin-only endpoints (Admin / Users, Admin / Roles) require a user with role=admin (the seeded admin@erp.test account works).
4. "Integrations → Public Lead Capture" is the one endpoint that does NOT use the bearer token — it's a public webhook secured by the X-Lead-Capture-Secret header instead (see backend/.env LEAD_CAPTURE_SECRET).

request.description: Saves the returned token into the {{token}} collection variable for every other request.
Set the :notification path variable to a notification UUID from the list above.

item.name: Admin / Roles

request.description: Increments the matching raw material's current_stock by the delta between the new and previous received_quantity.
Send either product_id (existing product) OR new_product (creates one) — not both.
Pending/in-progress/completed/skipped counts per process type — feeds the Production dashboard tiles.
Notifies the assigned system user (email + in-app) whenever status or assigned_to changes.
Only valid for a quality_check process — completes it and creates/finds the order's Delivery record.
Pulls in any order items added after this process was created (so they stop showing as "missed").

Alternative body: use "production_order_ids" instead of "process_ids" to move whole orders (including brand-new ones with no processes yet) into the target stage. Response includes "targets" — the exact order/process ids created or activated, for direct navigation.
Set :code to a Contact code (e.g. B2B-00001) or a Production Order no (e.g. PRD-00001) — used by the header search / barcode-style lookup.
Set the lead_capture_secret collection variable to your backend's LEAD_CAPTURE_SECRET (.env). No Authorization header needed — this route is outside auth:sanctum entirely.
